# Erdos.p364 — Erdős problem 364

Reference: https://www.erdosproblems.com/364
Imported from google-deepmind/formal-conjectures (`ErdosProblems/364.lean`, theorem `erdos_364`, AMS 11).

There is no consecutive triple of powerful numbers.

## Statement
¬ ∃ (n : ℕ), Powerful n ∧ Powerful (n + 1) ∧ Powerful (n + 2)

## Strategic notes
Open conjecture — prove-or-refute posture applies to sub-claims,
but the root asserts the conjectured statement itself. No
per-problem hints (benchmark integrity).
